fixes.explanation: Close, but no guest badges here, friend. The tribes tell David, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.” (2 Samuel 5:1) That's family talking, and family doesn't need a name tag.
Right on the money, baker. The tribes tell David, “…you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back.” (2 Samuel 5:2) And they say it about the days while Saul was still king.
You got it, baker. The tribes quote the LORD saying to David, “You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.” (2 Samuel 5:2) Shepherd AND ruler, both in one sentence.

Teaching sounds like a good fit, and I'd have picked it too. But the tribes quote the LORD saying, “You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.” (2 Samuel 5:2) No teach anywhere in that sentence, friend. Just shepherd and ruler, and I'd have been confidently wrong right next to you.

That's the one, baker. In Jerusalem David reigns “…thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.” (2 Samuel 5:5) Hebron's seven years and six months come first, and the verse before it gives his forty years as the whole reign. (2 Samuel 5:4)

Not quite, friend. The text says David reigns in Jerusalem “…thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.” (2 Samuel 5:5) Twenty-five isn't the number the verse gives. It's thirty-three, sitting right beside the seven years and six months in Hebron.

Twelve is way short, friend. David reigns in Jerusalem “…thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.” (2 Samuel 5:5) That's the longer stretch next to the seven years and six months in Hebron. Twelve doesn't come close to what the verse says.

Right, baker. Hiram, king of Tyre, sends envoys, cedar logs, carpenters and stonemasons, “…and they built a palace for David.” (2 Samuel 5:11) That's a good use of cedar. A whole crew and a pile of logs, all sent by the king of Tyre.

A tower is a fair guess with stonemasons on the job, friend. But the text says Hiram's carpenters and stonemasons “…built a palace for David.” (2 Samuel 5:11) Palace is the word, and I'd have said tower right along with you.
